step-1.text: Lean one side unit against the wall. Push shelf pins into the holes at the heights you want for the bottom and top shelves.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side unit and 4 shelf pins.

step-2.text: With a helper holding the side, rest the bottom shelf and the top shelf on their pins. The clips under each shelf grip the pins.

step-3.text: Pins into the second side unit at matching heights, then slide it under the free ends of the shelves.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side unit and 4 shelf pins.

step-4.text: Now the middle shelves. Pins in on both sides at the same height, then drop each shelf on.

count-4.text: This step uses 2 shelves and 8 shelf pins.

step-5.text: Screw the metal X-brace across the back. It is what stops the whole thing leaning sideways, so do not skip it.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 x-brace and 4 screws.

step-6.text: Fix the top of a side unit to the wall with a bracket and screws that suit your wall. Tall and narrow means anchor it, always.

done.text: Done. Your IVAR shelving unit is built. Give it a proud little pat.
